dedupe_keys.name: regional charging behavior simulation model rcbsm

description: Regional Charging Behavior Simulation Model (RCBSM) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by University of Würzburg. - Simulation of spatiotemporal charging energy demand at the regional level - Modeling of impact factors on individual charging behavior including parameters as mobility patterns, price sensitivity, access to charging infrastructure, or vehicle properties such as energy consumption or battery capacity - Derive charging load profiles at municipal level for charging infrastructure at home ... Coverage: Germany, United Kingdom, Ukraine. Methodical focus: Electric Vehicles, Agent-Based Simulation, Charging Energy Demand. Time resolution: 15 min, 1 min. Spatial resolution: regions, NUTS 3, municipalities, districts, households, power stations. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Unknown. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
